Short title and commencement

ACT XII OF 1965
ACT XII OF 1965
ANTI‑CORRUPTION LAWS AMENDMENT ACT, 1965
1. Short title and
commencement.‑(1) This Act. may be called the Anti‑Corruption
Laws Amendment Act, 1965.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of anti corruption laws

ACT XII OF 1965
ACT XII OF 1965
ANTI‑CORRUPTION LAWS AMENDMENT ACT, 1965
2. Amendment of anti‑corruption laws.‑The
laws specified in column I of the Schedule below shall, in their application to
persons who belong to the All Pakistan Services or the other services of the
Center or hold posts connected with the affairs of the Center, be amended in
the manner provided in column II of that Schedule.
